name: etf-tracking
description: Static ETF TOP10 holdings tracking dashboard with daily data updater.

scripts.build: npm run build:platform && npm run build:site
scripts.test:node: node --check assets/app.js && node --check shared-platform/src/index.js && node --check scripts/static-smoke.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/static-smoke.mjs
